fields.v: Proposes an approach; secondary: Evaluates — EPIC framework of 40 specification-writing practices in 10 quality dimensions and 4 categories, with a 0-3 scoring rubric and an agent skill (review and authoring modes); evaluated by mixed methods: rubric scoring of 114 OSS SDD repositories, grey-literature review of 30 sources, practitioner interviews (N=15), observational association of spec-quality scores with SonarQube/GitHub outcomes

fields.v: EPIC prescribes no artefacts of its own; it gives quality practices for the SDD artefact set: specification, plan and tasks (also context files such as AGENTS.md in the skill example). Practices include [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers, measurable bounds, normative MUST/SHALL wording, stable unique requirement IDs, explicit template declaration, verification criteria and completion conditions, dependency/failure handling, requirements-to-implementation traceability

Automatic: SonarQube Community Build 26.9 + SonarScanner CLI 8.0.1 on latest commit (12 Sep 2026); GitHub REST API. Stats: Spearman, one-sided Mann-Whitney U, Cliff's delta, Benjamini-Hochberg

H3 complexity/KLOC: 137.2 vs 162.3 (-15.4%, p = 0.001, delta = -0.419); rho = -0.206 (p = 0.021). H4: bug-fix commit rate 11.8% vs 20.4% (pBH = 0.034; rho = -0.210, pBH = 0.046); contributors 12.5 vs 3; PRs 202.5 vs 89; all activity measures significant (pBH <= 0.048)
